Equivalence is coverage-level, not verdict-level: OmaSafe findings and marketplace baseline outcomes are independent systems.

Every external finding and capability id from Baseline V3 is mapped below; an id may carry several OmaSafe mappings when multiple rules participate, and every mapping has an explicit coverage relation.
